prompt: Design a quote-age policy that uses timestamps rather than a number of rows. List the metadata required.
answer: Propose a source-specific maximum age of30 elapsed minutes,inclusive at the boundary,for eligible last-known quotes. Require aware event/observation time,publication/ingestion or defensible availability time,valuation time and decision cutoff; instrument/venue,currency,units,adjustment basis,source/revision and session/calendar context. Normalize instants,require event_time<=valuation_time and availability_time<=decision_cutoff,and enforce0<=valuation_time−event_time<=30minutes. Select only from records actually eligible at the decision cutoff,with a documented tie/revision policy; preserve selected source timestamp,age and carry flag. Reject or withhold beyond-limit/missing/incompatible inputs; never use bfill to satisfy this rule. Thirty minutes is a proposed teaching policy,not a universal financial threshold. No quote-age selector/calendar integration was implemented.
